historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; extracts displayed Current Speed lines without raw field, socket mapping or metadata-versus-live semantics.

original_test_intent: Verify the SMBIOS Type 4 Current Speed metadata for every expected processor record matches the project-approved firmware representation in MHz or supported unknown value and remains correct after reboot. It must not be silently redefined as instantaneous OS core frequency.
original_method: Capture all raw/decoded Type 4 records at a defined post-boot point, bind by socket/status, compare the raw 16-bit Current Speed and decoded MHz with the approved SMBIOS baseline and valid Max Speed relationship, reboot and repeat under the same collection phase; collect live frequency only as a separate approved cross-check.
manual_activity: A user approves the SMBIOS metadata baseline, collection phase, consistency policy and reboot plan. Collection and comparison are automatable.
required_inputs: Approved Type 4 Current Speed MHz or zero/unknown value per socket
Defined post-boot collection phase and any allowed firmware-population variation
Current Speed versus Max Speed consistency rule
Optional separately approved live-frequency cross-check; validated tooling and reboot/OOB plan
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS/CPU inventory only; do not change governors, turbo, workloads, clocks, voltage or firmware.
Preserve raw 16-bit values, decoded MHz, all Type 4 records and errors; grep fragments are incomplete.
Do not assume the field is a live sample or require arbitrary tolerance unless the project documents dynamic firmware population.
Apply Max/Current consistency only when both values are valid and use any live OS frequency solely as separately scoped evidence.
Stop on invalid units, missing/duplicate records, unexplained metadata drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete Type 4 data at the approved boot phase, bind sockets/status, compare raw/decoded Current Speed and defined Max-Speed consistency before/after reboot.
Do not manipulate performance state, substitute live frequency for SMBIOS metadata or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the expected metadata values, boot-phase timing, zero/variation and consistency rules.
Decide any separate live-frequency correlation and issue the metadata-case verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is correct, but grep loses raw/socket context, suppresses errors and cannot distinguish static SMBIOS representation from live frequency.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete decoded/raw Type 4 output with tool/errors at a defined boot phase, bind each record by socket/status and retain Current Speed with Max Speed and CPU identity.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Current Speed scope, Type 4 script and 10/10-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat Current Speed first as a raw firmware-populated Type 4 field, capture it at a reproducible post-boot phase, compare raw/decoded MHz per socket and check only approved Max-Speed consistency; keep dynamic OS sampling separate.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, parser/dmidecode, BIOS, CPU, boot phase and platform-recipe revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 4 Current Speed semantics, approved platform recipe and installed tooling documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw per-socket and collection-phase provenance while preventing a silent scope change into runtime frequency testing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; live-frequency behavior remains separately auditable if requested.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected metadata, phase and variation policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some firmware may populate a configured rather than instantaneous value; the field alone does not prove runtime frequency behavior.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve exact persistence, a named set/range of firmware-populated values or zero/unknown at a defined phase, but must not base this metadata verdict on an unrelated instantaneous OS sample.
expected_evidence: Approval, expected per-socket Current Speed/phase/variation/consistency policy and tool/SMBIOS versions
Complete pre-reboot Type 4 table with timestamp/boot phase/raw/decoded Current and correlated Max Speed
Complete post-reboot capture under the same phase and semantic comparison
Engineer verdict and separately labeled live-frequency evidence if required

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item and persistence criterion target the SMBIOS field; the generic word `Current` does not require a live OS frequency test.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The metadata field is safe to read; expected value and collection-phase rules are readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds complete record, raw field, boot-phase and Max-Speed context.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains state-awareness but corrects the assumption that exact comparison is inherently invalid and prevents scope substitution; capability is FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Makes firmware metadata authoritative for this row while preserving optional live evidence as a separate scope.

review_improvement: Prevents runtime-frequency variability from obscuring an actual SMBIOS metadata defect and prevents performance manipulation to force an expected number.
independent_technical_reasoning: Once the project defines the firmware metadata baseline and capture phase, all read/map/compare/reboot actions are software-controlled.
